WITH ss_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS cnt_b1,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS avg_ext_b1,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS avg_net_b1,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS cnt_b2,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS avg_ext_b2,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS avg_net_b2,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS cnt_b3,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS avg_ext_b3,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS avg_net_b3,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS cnt_b4,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS avg_ext_b4,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS avg_net_b4,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS cnt_b5,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS avg_ext_b5,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS avg_net_b5
    FROM store_sales
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN ss_stats.cnt_b1 > 1071 THEN ss_stats.avg_ext_b1 ELSE ss_stats.avg_net_b1 END AS bucket1,
    CASE WHEN ss_stats.cnt_b2 > 39161 THEN ss_stats.avg_ext_b2 ELSE ss_stats.avg_net_b2 END AS bucket2,
    CASE WHEN ss_stats.cnt_b3 > 29434 THEN ss_stats.avg_ext_b3 ELSE ss_stats.avg_net_b3 END AS bucket3,
    CASE WHEN ss_stats.cnt_b4 > 6568 THEN ss_stats.avg_ext_b4 ELSE ss_stats.avg_net_b4 END AS bucket4,
    CASE WHEN ss_stats.cnt_b5 > 21216 THEN ss_stats.avg_ext_b5 ELSE ss_stats.avg_net_b5 END AS bucket5
FROM reason
JOIN ss_stats ON reason.r_reason_sk = 1
WHERE reason.r_reason_sk = 1
